# Alex Csaky

> AI safety researcher and founder working on AI for epistemics and coordination. Astra Fellow (strategy and governance). Oxford anthropology. Personal site: https://alexcsaky.com/

This file is for language models. Prefer it over scraping layout. Human pages: [About](https://alexcsaky.com/) and [Reading / Writing](https://alexcsaky.com/writing). Markdown mirrors: [index.md](https://alexcsaky.com/index.md), [writing.md](https://alexcsaky.com/writing.md).

Canonical name: **Alex Csaky**.

## Who

Alex Csaky is an AI safety researcher and founder working on AI for epistemics and coordination. He is an [Astra Fellow](https://constellation.org/programs/astra) on the strategy and governance stream, working out where the field most needs accelerating, and consults on enterprise AI transformation through [Proferra](https://proferra.org/), with a focus on better organisational coordination.

Previously: contracted with [Forethought](https://www.forethought.org/) as a founder in residence, scoping the field of AI for epistemics and coordination; [Talos](https://www.talosnetwork.org/) Policy Leaders Fellow (EU AI governance); [Apart](https://apartresearch.com/) Studio Fellow (sycophancy evals); facilitator on BlueDot's [AGI Strategy course](https://bluedot.org/courses/agi-strategy). Before AI safety he founded and sold an e-commerce startup while at secondary school, ran an education company in Hong Kong, and worked as an AI engineer building tools for enterprises and political candidates. He read archaeology and anthropology at Oxford (excavation at [Castelo de Cuncos](https://www.castelodecuncosproject.com/); dissertation on human cognitive enhancement).

## Work and artefacts

- [Syco-Lingual](https://drive.google.com/file/d/1eiPNwKIuWtGbWlBsFRdoDE4I6Yf7R8FO/view): short paper on multilingual sycophancy evaluation; presented at [IASEAI'26](https://www.iaseai.org/) Paris. Code: [github.com/alexcsaky/syco-lingual](https://github.com/alexcsaky/syco-lingual).
- Hosting: co-runs the [AI Safety Cinema Society](https://luma.com/kp2cff0u) in London (first screening: Daniel Roher's "The AI Doc: Or How I Became an Apocaloptimist" and Suzy Shepherd's "Seat at the Table"). Organises workshops and hackathons. Also hosts dinners and events for friends.
- Anthropology and Futurism: essay on AI personhood for Scheme magazine, arguing personhood is made through relationships rather than crossed as a threshold ([semi-finished draft](https://docs.google.com/document/d/1YOCFeEOWer5-YHvAE5T7p64CQtV5vrJy/edit?usp=sharing)); [Marlboro Men and Modern Myths](https://alexcsaky.substack.com/p/marlboro-men-and-modern-myths-chasing); [How to Buy Honour and Build a City](https://graduand.substack.com/p/how-to-buy-honour-and-build-a-city).
- Other interests: lucid dreaming and contemplative practice (how the mind works and its hidden limits); built a small house in Croatia ([photo](https://alexcsaky.com/house.jpg), [sketch](https://alexcsaky.com/sketch.jpg)); [Civilization 5](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Civilization_V) and [6](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Civilization_VI).
- Outdoors: favourite hikes are [Dragon's Back](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Dragon%27s_Back) (Hong Kong), the [Goetheweg](https://nordkette.com/en/hiking-trails/the-goetheweg/) (Innsbruck), the [South Downs Way](https://www.nationaltrail.co.uk/en_GB/trails/south-downs-way/) (Sussex and Hampshire), and [Doi Inthanon](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Doi_Inthanon) (Chiang Mai). Still aiming to hike the [Pacific Crest Trail](https://www.pcta.org/). Skiing at [Patscherkofel](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Patscherkofel) (Innsbruck) and [Hakuba Valley](https://www.hakubavalley.com/) (Japan). Sea kayaking in [Istria](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Istria) and [Cornwall](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Cornwall).
